scope: Algebraic reconstruction on a saved history-only trajectory; original source functions only. No race, controller substitution, or acceptance claim.
activeForecast: current strain, as actually emitted by native helper
limitations: Current-force plans retain the exact captured current-strain forecast/target and alter only capacity in the old stopping formula; they are offline counterfactual requests, not executed controls.
The unbounded endpoint reserve is reported separately from the existing 2g cap and from the additional measured-force/nominal-lean reserve actually used for allocation.
A changed final force pair or missing endpoint bound is not by itself proof of the initial cause of the eventual fall.
These data cover only four seconds before the first fall; earlier behavior is not reconstructed.
